# catalystcenter_application_set (Resource)

Manages a custom Catalyst Center Application Set. Built-in application sets must not be managed by this resource. The API does not support updates, so changing a configurable attribute replaces the application set. `terraform import` expects the controller-assigned UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "catalystcenter_application_set" "example" {
  name                           = "my-app-set"
  default_business_relevance     = "BUSINESS_RELEVANT"
  scalable_group_external_handle = "my-app-set"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_business_relevance` (String) The business relevance this application set defaults to. It determines which column the set is pre-populated into in the Application Policy GUI; an application policy may still override it per policy.
  - Choices: `BUSINESS_RELEVANT`, `BUSINESS_IRRELEVANT`, `DEFAULT`
- `name` (String) The name of the application set.

### Optional

- `scalable_group_external_handle` (String) External handle of the application set. Set to the same value as `name`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import catalystcenter_application_set.example "<id>"
```
